fightSong.title: Smells Like Team Spirit
fightSong.lyrics: Flannel on and coffee strong / Seattle grunge all game long / Turn the amps up, let it bleed / Grunge football, that's what we need!

stadium.name: The Garage
stadium.tradition: The Feedback — guitars feedback for 11 seconds pre-game (one for each player). If it sustains, good omen.

fanCulture.description: They wear flannel in September. After big plays they headbang. It's loud, it's rainy, it's perfect.
fanCulture.tailgate: With coffee, in the rain, under a tarp.

rivalries.name: The Fog Bowl
rivalries.narrative: Grunge vs sourdough. Both damp, both proud.

cityFlavor: Coffee, rain, and music that changed the world. We invented flannel football.
